// Positive control (#5170): the failure is "used" (`void err`) and an empty answer returned — not a
// literal-only statement list, yet the same collapse of "could not look" into "nothing there".
import fs from 'node:fs';

export function readPlanText(planPath: string): string {
  try {
    return fs.readFileSync(planPath, 'utf8');
  } catch (err) {
    void err;
    return '';
  }
}
